name: Broccolini
siboNotes: Generally well-tolerated for SIBO as it's low in fermentable carbohydrates. Cook thoroughly to improve digestibility.
preparationTips: Steam or sauté lightly to maintain crispness and nutrients
Trim tough stem ends before cooking
Blanch briefly in salted water then shock in ice bath for vibrant color
Drizzle with garlic-infused oil instead of fresh garlic
nutritionalHighlights: High in vitamin C and folate
Good source of vitamin K for bone health
